text: No significant tree-cover loss (0.5 ha or more) was detected on this 130.9-ha rural property after 2020, based on satellite analysis up to 2025. The asset had minimal tree cover in 2000 (0.4 ha) and was classified as non-forest in 2020. While the data rules out large-scale deforestation, smaller changes (under 0.5 ha) or edge losses might have occurred but weren’t captured due to the 30-meter pixel resolution. The evidence doesn’t confirm compliance with regulations like EUDR, nor does it provide details on the cause of any changes. Observations were valid for the full asset area.
